item.title: Obsidian: Your Second Brain, Built on Plain Text
item.description: Obsidian: Your Second Brain, Built on Plain Text Let’s agree on one thing Obsidian is easily one of the best choices you can make when it comes to note-taking apps. Over the years, I’ve tried more note-taking apps than I can count — from good old Windows Notepad and Samsung Notes (back when it was still called S Note!) all the way to Notion, MS Word, Apple Notes, Google Keep, Evernote, OneNote, Roam Research, Logseq, and Craft.
